method.scope: Only benchmark IOC values; live positive-control IPs are excluded

interpretation: Zero matches are limited to the applicable benchmark IP population; neither source was expected to query domain, URL, MD5, or SHA256 records.
FeodoTracker and Tor positive-control tests passed against current live feeds, so zero benchmark matches are not evidence that either integration is broken.
Do not convert no-match or missing cache rows into a CLEAN verdict or production weight of zero.
Do not rerun CV for these sources until a source-specific positive-control dataset is available.
